title: Routine 4-dose PCV series completed by age 2 years
grade: ACIP routine recommendation (CDC schedule; not graded)
action: Ensure child has received the 4-dose pneumococcal conjugate vaccine series (2, 4, 6, 12-15 months)

derived.min: final dose is due at 12-15 months, so all 4 doses are expected by the 2nd birthday; children turning 2 in the measurement year are checked
derived.max: same reasoning: check the cohort turning 2 in the measurement year

derived.window: a child turning 2 in the measurement year was born in {MY-2}, so doses since birth fall within {MY-2}-01-01 to {MY}-12-31

numerator.note: Does not verify doses fell at 2, 4, 6 and 12-15 months, nor that the 4th dose was given before the 2nd birthday.
